acceptanceCriteria: Successful mutation results carry the issuedAt used (spec + wire contract updated), or the spec records why not.
A test shows a lost-output retry after a later update recovers and replays.
body: Residual from V1-1384 (PR #935, head 36f577b9d, CAL-V0-250). When --issued-at is omitted the CLI defaults issuedAt to the current second, which is part of the request digest (TM-V0-006). CAL-V0-250 makes the REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT refusal name issuedAt when the recorded ticket's createdAt/updatedAt (or up to 2 s earlier) reproduces the digest. Expected: a caller can always recover the issuedAt to replay with. Actual: if the first output was lost and the ticket was later updated, the refusal can only list the generic digest inputs. Reproduce: create without --issued-at, update the ticket, retry the original create. Fix changes the result shape (wire contract).

title: corvint-tasks mutation results do not report the defaulted issuedAt, so a lost-output retry cannot recover it
